title: FaceTape
overview: A junkie decides to come clean from abusing an analog VR drug called FaceTape only to find his life outside of his addiction is far from stable.

title: The Wronged of Juiced
overview: Gus sees a boy drinking juice. It is not the same as he remembers.

title: National Theatre at Home: Pride
overview: Summer 1984. The UK is in turmoil. With Thatcher battling to dismantle the coal industry, and a lethal pandemic on the rise, 24-year-old activist Mark Ashton founds an unlikely new alliance with the pit communities of South Wales: Lesbians and Gays Support the Miners. Funny, fierce and filled with joy, what follows is the incredible true story of two disparate communities joining forces – and making history. This brand-new musical unites Matthew Warchus and Stephen Beresford, director and writer of the hit film Pride, with composers Christopher Nightingale, Josh Cohen, and DJ Walde. Together they share the inspiring story of these real-life events, featuring original songs inspired by protest anthems, pop, rock, disco and the Welsh choral tradition.

title: Traços de Fuga
overview: Diana retreats into drawing and music to escape the chaos of her home. Each page of her notebook becomes an extension of the emotions she cannot bring herself to say out loud. But when even the smallest moments of peace are interrupted, Diana realizes that mentally escaping may no longer be enough to cope with the reality she lives in.

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie -Walpurgisnacht: Rising-
overview: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

title: Wild Horse Nine
overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

title: Under Your Feet
overview: Isabel moves with her two children into a very prestigious building that has a very peculiar admission method but at a very affordable rental fee. Once approved and settled, three elderly neighbors from the lower floor will turn their lives upside down.

title: The Table: Day and Night
overview: In a bustling café where lives briefly intersect, serendipity takes centre stage. A man and a woman share the same eccentric dream – will fate bring them together? Old classmates run into each other after years: a sweet second chance or a bitter reality check? A director approaches a novelist he admires to find out if the connection on page is merely delusional. A K-idol meets her first love, where the prospect of parting ways leaves them feeling wistful.

title: A Ray of Sunlight
overview: Okhee is a lower-class diver in the city. One day, Eunyoung, the daughter of her late husband, comes to visit. What’s more, Kyeongsik, Okhee’s son, who is being chased by creditors, leaves his young son Junseo with them and disappears. Eunyoung wasn’t planning to stay long but misses the chance to leave due to Okhee's accident and the appearance of her step-nephew, Junseo. Eunyoung starts to live together with Okhee, but everything feels uncomfortable.

title: Species
overview: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

title: Final Interview
overview: Six college students meet at the final interview of a global IT company. Growing closer as they prepare for the group discussion, they dare to dream that all six might make it — until the day before the interview, when the company announces its verdict: only one will be hired. On the day of the interview, mysterious envelopes arrive, each containing one of their secrets — and suspicion begins to take hold. Who among the six is the liar?

title: The Foul-Mouthed Granny
overview: A man's loving memories of tending to his acerbic mother weave together remembrance, routine, and artistry in a lyrical reflection on familial bonds, loss, and generational connections.

title: Goodbye Eri The Fan Film Live Action
overview: Yago, following a personal request from his ailing mother, begins to document his life through recordings. This film project takes an unexpected turn when it becomes intertwined with a mysterious figure named Eri, exploring the fine line between reality and fiction whilst grappling with grief and artistic creation.

title: THE APE OF GOD
overview: A happening that connects perspectives of lost souls discovering a mysterious chain of voyeurism and obsession, that leads them to encounter the devil.

title: Chili Finger
overview: When a small town lawyer discovers a severed finger in her chili, she blackmails the restaurant for a cash payout in an effort to regain control over her mundane life. The situation quickly spirals out of control, and her life descends into chaos.

title: Under the City Lights
overview: The story of two friends, a boy and a girl, finding more about each other during their long walks around Rome.

title: National Theatre Live: Golden Boy
overview: Josh O’Connor (The Crown; Challengers) leads the cast in this searing revival of Clifford Odets’ knockout American classic.  1930s New York, at the height of the Depression. Joe Bonaparte is a gifted young violinist with a future in music, until a chance at fame and fortune lures him into the brutal world of professional boxing. He must confront what he’s willing to sacrifice, who he’s willing to become and how to find his place in a world that demands he choose a side.  Brought to life with a live string quartet and filmed live from the Almeida Theatre, Olivier Award-winner Sam Yates (Vanya) directs this propulsive drama exploring ambition, identity, and the high price of success.

title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

title: Kathanar - The Wild Sorcerer
overview: Based on the tales of Kadamattathu Kathanar, the legendary priest who is believed to have lived in Kadamattom and possessed supernatural powers.

title: The Cat in the Hat
overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

title: 7G Rainbow Colony 2
overview: Nearly 10 years post the tragic death of Anitha, Kathir's ailing mother makes desperate attempts to get him settled after sensing his attraction to the daughter of Flat No.7G's Newest Tenant.

title: Arasan
overview: Taking place as an untold story in the same world as Vetrimaaran's Vadachennai, a man holds a struggling, dark past in the 1990s.

title: Untitled Abbott Le-Eldred Film
overview: No details have been provided for this film yet.

title: In search of the Griffin
overview: It seems to me that the image of the griffin in my film represents something mythical, something ancient that once existed but which we have forgotten how to see and believe in. In this sense, the Griffin stands on the same level as the myth of Revolution and Love. And I would like to prove to everyone, just as I proved the existence of the Griffin in my dream, that true love and revolution—a change in the world order—are still possible despite the challenges ahead.

title: The Wayans Bros. Reunion
overview: Join Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, and Anna Maria Horsford for a fast‑paced and laugh‑filled night celebrating the sitcom that ran for five seasons and became one of the most memorable comedy series of the 90s. This special takes a look at the show’s origin and evolution through candid interviews with the cast and original directors, featuring classic clips, behind‑the‑scenes stories, and the brothers’ unfiltered commentary on how their unique comedic style shaped every episode. Packed with never‑before‑seen moments and genuine reflections, the reunion highlights everything fans loved about The Wayans Bros. while staying true to the show’s signature humor and energy.

title: The Virgin Suicides
overview: A group of male friends become obsessed with five mysterious sisters who are sheltered by their strict, religious parents.

title: Cardcaptor Sakura: The Sealed Card
overview: All of the Clow Cards have been captured, and Sakura Kinomoto, the new Master of the Cards, is preparing to play the lead in the play for the town festival. However, a new evil force is causing mysterious events all over Tomoeda, including the disappearance of Sakura's cards. With Syaoran's help, Sakura must figure out the cause of these events, and save her town.

title: The Conductor
overview: Leonard Bernstein’s protégée Marin Alsop reveals how she smashed the glass ceiling to become an internationally renowned conductor.

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: Mother Mary
overview: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

title: De Gaulle: Résistance
overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

title: The Bus
overview: After serving ten years in prison for a murder he did not commit, a man is finally released. Determined to take revenge on the detective who framed him, he tracks him down—only to discover that the detective has already died.

title: Margie Claus
overview: When Santa goes missing Christmas Eve, his wife Margie Claus has to assemble a rag-tag team of long-retired reindeer to rescue Santa and save Christmas

title: Pressure
overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

title: Halo
overview: Min-joon, 27, who bears the burden of his broken family, delivers packages every day, dreaming of being a film director. A soothsayer lights a flame within him. Daily repetition and slippage create unique rhythms.

title: Horoomon
overview: One woman. One racist lie. One lawsuit that shook Japan. Korean Japanese entrepreneur Shin Sugok takes on major media in this electro-shock legal thriller about refusing to be silenced.

title: Ebenezer
overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

title: Uncle, Where Are You Going?
overview: A peculiar journey begins on Jeju Island. The artists transform into Sim Bong-sa and Ppaengdeok Eomeoni, slipping into a playful parody of The Tale of Simcheong, where reality and performance blur. A philosophical yet joyful road movie about failed artists restoring themselves.

title: Against The Clock
overview: Two brothers on the hunt. One man racing against time. Which one will get what they need first?

title: IVDICO
overview: Summer, 2010. Sunyoung (38), a former judge turned lawyer, runs her own law office while raising her daughter alone after a divorce. As the time to pick up her daughter Sohee approaches, a legal consultation with a middle-aged man named Sangryeol who arrives late holds her back. The longer the consultation drags on, the further his words stray from the law, and the conversation slowly curdles into an inexplicable unease.

title: While You're Here
overview: Yi-wan and Hwa-ran, a young couple with nothing but dreams and love, decide to leave their tiny dorm room to live together. However, they fall victim to a rental scam and struggle to find a home, moving from place to place. Eventually, they end up in a moldy basement apartment. Can they hold onto their dreams and escape?

title: White Blast
overview: At a remote train station covered in heavy snow, a station master Gap-su is facing the last day of his life-long dedication to the station. Devastated by the sudden layoffs, Gap-su keeps waiting for his young replacement, who still hasn’t yet come. As the hush reigns throughout the station, Gap-su sees the breaking news that dozens of convicts escaped from the overturned prison bus, and just then, a young man walks into the station claiming himself as the one Gap-su has been waiting for.

title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

title: Other Mommy
overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

title: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
overview: The school’s cool, prince-like heroine has never questioned her role—until a fellow “Prince” enters her life and sees her as more than a hero, awakening feelings she’s never faced before.

title: sometimes, I... - The Breakdown
overview: A breakdown of every aspect of the production of the short film 'Sometimes, I...'

title: Snow in June
overview: A man unexpectedly meets his first love — a woman who died in a car accident three years earlier. Realising the past and present have become intertwined, he takes her on an impossible journey across Mongolia.

title: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince
overview: Eun Woo infiltrates the palace to kill Crown Prince Lee Hyun, only to fall in love with him.

title: LIM YOUNG WOONG | IM HERO THE STADIUM 2
The Death of Robin Hood
overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: Torment
overview: An exhausted security guard is transferred to a morgue and, on their first night, discovers that the shadows and silences hide a torment from which there may be no return.

title: Разыскивается Дед Мороз
overview: On New Year's Eve, a not-so-lucky thief, Misha, breaks into a house in the very center of Moscow, where a lonely old man lives. Misha hopes to improve his unenviable financial situation and bring back his family - his wife and seven-year-old daughter. However, in the old man's big house, he finds nothing of any value, except for the deposits of children's toys in the basement. The old man himself assures him that he is none other than the real Father Frost.

title: Keluarga Tak Berencana
overview: Plot Unknown.

title: Pretty Boy
overview: It's easy to be a pretty boy, but it's not easy to love one

title: The Hunger Games Series
overview: The Hunger Games is a dystopian science-fiction film series based on the novels by Suzanne Collins. Set in the ruined nation of Panem, the story follows young "tributes" forced to fight to the death in a televised arena. The saga follows heroine Katniss Everdeen as she sparks a national rebellion against the oppressive Capitol.

title: How To Become A Flight Attendant
overview: How To Become A Flight Attendant is a American biography which features American Actress Alana Spence and the rest of the cast from The First Class Cadet.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
overview: Part two of a two-part biopic following French army officer Charles De Gaulle's life and political commitment between 1940 and 1945, and trace his development towards a political career.

title: Tristes Tropiques
overview: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.

title: Focker-in-Law
overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: Layover Hotel
overview: A flight from Incheon to London's Kingsford Smith Airport is canceled due to an engine malfunction, and passengers are provided with a complimentary overnight stay at a layover hotel. Six strangers, unexpectedly stranded together, each have a unique and unforeseen experience throughout the night. This temporary stay becomes a moment of reflection on their lives.

title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

title: My Home
overview: Gyu-bin, a college student without a home, is struggling to meet her basic needs. One day, she's offered a place to stay by Geum-rim, an elderly woman living in a luxurious house. Geum-rim warmly welcomes her and treats her like a granddaughter. But soon, Gyu-bin senses something is off. She suffers from nightmares and feels a strange presence in the house. She has no choice but to stay, but can she survive what's coming?

title: Hexed
overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

title: A Poet of the River
overview: An 18-year-old North Korean defector, Lee Sun-hwa, crosses the Duman River, traversing the thin boundary between life and death, and arrives in South Korea. Upon completing her resettlement program at Hanawon, she is placed in a public housing unit in Nowon, Seoul. Yet, life in the South feels like an uncharted world. Choosing to enroll in a South Korean high school rather than extend her stay at Hanawon, she soon finds herself struggling—both academically and culturally. Her only wish is to reunite with her family.

title: The Sparkle Switch
overview: "Get ready to sing, dance, and completely lose your mind! From the studio that brought you the massive theatrical smash hit comes The Sparkle Switch, a non-stop, high-octane musical ride that is taking over the world!

title: Raphael
overview: Alexei, an elite war android modeled after the youthful image of an aging dictator, serves as commanding officer in a refugee district, leading the suppression of a rebellion. There, he encounters Michael, the last remaining Catholic priest, and awakens to faith—beginning a dangerous journey in search of redemption.

title: Fogaréu
overview: On the border between the real and the fantastic, between the colonial past and the overwhelming modernity of agribusiness, the city of Goiás is the scene of the meeting between the young Fernanda and her secret roots. She returns to the home of her wealthy uncle, after the death of her adoptive mother, in order to implode the certainties and to reveal the painful truth about its origin.

title: Plastic Guns
overview: A standoff reveals unsettling truths for an old cowboy.

title: Eureka or (The Quest for Nothing)
overview: A lonely surfer sets out to find the holy grail.

title: Kyle and Eric's Quest for the Golden Bong
overview: Two stoners go on an epic journey, filled with trials and challanges after finding a scroll that tells of a legendary lost artifact

title: Economy-Man: Black Friday
overview: Distraught with emotion after letting Mr. Knoflick destroy half the universe, Economy-Man sits at a crossroads, knowing he must stop Knoflick before the entire economy is destroyed but searching for a team who can help him beat this seemingly unassailable foe. Meanwhile, three other lost heroes lives intersect with his: Loggo, searching for his best friend, who thinks he is dead; Fry-Man, grieving after giving up the mask after the tragic death of his girlfriend, Gwel; and Bob the Soap, a once proud warrior who finds himself lonelier than ever. The four heroes, shrouded with loneliness, will band together to stop Knoflick from destroying the economy, but can they defeat him and his army before it's too late? The entire Economy-Man saga has led to this.

title: CIRCA 1919: A Hollywood Murder
overview: On the production of the first western epic, a story-hungry journalist gets her break when a "prop gun" kills an actor.
